What we do

Trade support for everyday property operations.

A single local contact for work-order intake, site access coordination and documented completion. We can quote one trial job or discuss recurring work, subject to the scope and team schedule.

01

Appliance Installation

Dishwashers, laundry equipment, range hoods, OTR microwaves and selected built-in appliance replacements within licensed, permitted and insured scope.

02

Minor Maintenance

Drywall patching, mounting, shelving, assembly, minor carpentry and other non-structural tasks within the agreed scope.

03

Turnover & Make-Ready

Small repairs, condition reporting, punch-list items and cleaning coordination before tenant handover or property occupancy.
